# Pacifique

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Pacifique is a young man who is exceedingly tall, thin, plain, and tattered in appearance. He has a dark-skinned, circular countenance with dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P26](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0026)_

## History

Pacifique worked as a hired hand for [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) Fletcher. Following a stormy night while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever, Pacifique informed [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the next morning that Hugh had survived the crisis and would recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P26](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0026)_
